title: Sitemap · URL Paths
subject: main
summary: One place that shows every URL of the seed baseline as a tree, with what each path shows — so a product slice adds its own paths beside these instead of gues…

axioms.text: A URL path is the contract between navigation and the app: every screen the user can land on has a path; a modal window is not a path.

sub: Route params (`:organizationId`) name the thing on screen.
`:current` is resolved by the front end to the active organization; the back end never sees it.

purpose.intro: One place that shows every URL of the seed baseline as a tree, with what each path shows — so a product slice adds its own paths beside these instead of guessing where they go.
points: The tree is the baseline: account, organizations, settings, legal.
Each node can carry the screenshot of the screen it lands on.

reference.statement: The tree as it stands. Public paths need no session; protected paths need an authenticated user. `/settings` lives under `/my`.

claims.text: `/my` groups everything about the signed-in user: memberships, invitations, settings.
`/organizations/:organizationId` and `/organizations/:current` render the same pages; `:current` is a front-end alias for the active organization.
`/legal-documents/*` is public and takes `?orgTypeId` and `?docId` as query parameters.
`/resolve` is where unmet requirements are resolved before the user continues.
